name: Kidlope
look: a chibi black goat-kid with long rabbit ears, little horns, huge yellow eyes, a leafy ruff and a sprouting leaf tail
entry: A playful kid of the deep woods. It nibbles leaves until they grow into a ruff round its neck, and loves to steal shiny things from travellers, then bound away laughing.
how: Wild: uncommon in forests at night (dark forests especially).
